description: This Java source file defines a helper class `DelinquencyRangesHelper` for integration testing in the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to perform CRUD operations on delinquency ranges via REST API calls and contains utility functions for preparing JSON payloads.

classes.name: DelinquencyRangesHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing delinquency ranges via REST API in integration tests.

methods.name: getDelinquencyRanges
methods.description: Retrieves a list of delinquency ranges from the server.

methods.name: getDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Retrieves a specific delinquency range by resource ID.

methods.name: createDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Creates a new delinquency range using a JSON payload.

methods.name: updateDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Updates an existing delinquency range identified by resource ID.

methods.name: deleteDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Deletes a delinquency range by resource ID.

methods.name: getAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing a delinquency range with specified ages.
